summary: This document defines requirements for Distributed Mobility Management at the network layer. Traditional wireless networks rely on centrally placed mobility anchors, but as networks flatten, it can help to spread mobility functions so traffic need not pass through a central point.

eli5.summary: When you move around with your phone, someone keeps track of where to send your data. Instead of one big office doing it for everyone, this RFC asks what is needed to share the job across many places.
